messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD: Recent developments in discrimination law
messages.plaintextBody:
You're invited to a CPD session on 24 April, 12:30–13:30 in Room 4B, covering recent EAT decisions on age and disability discrimination and the latest Vento bands. Sandwiches provided. RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.

Best,
K&L Team
